title: Affiliate Program
content:
Affiliate Program:

Join the "momuto" Affiliate Program and become a valued partner in promoting our customized soccer jerseys.
As an affiliate, you can earn commissions for driving sales through your unique referral links and sharing the love for personalized jerseys with your audience.

How It Works:

Apply to become an affiliate by sending us E-mail (info@mamutoteams.com), then filling out our application form.

Upon approval, you will receive a unique affiliate ID and access to our affiliate platform.

Use your affiliate ID to generate customized referral links and track the traffic and sales you generate.

Share your referral links on your website, blog, social media, or other channels to promote "momuto" products.

Benefits for Affiliates:

Earn competitive commission rates on each sale made through your referral links.

Access a variety of eye-catching banners, graphics, and marketing materials to enhance your promotional efforts.

Benefit from our high conversion rates and quality products, increasing the potential for earning significant commissions.

Receive timely payouts and access to detailed reports to track your performance and commission earnings.

Program Terms and Conditions:

Commissions are earned on qualifying sales generated through your referral links.

Commissions are paid on a regular basis, subject to a minimum payout threshold.

Violation of our affiliate program terms and conditions may result in termination from the program.

We reserve the right to modify the commission structure and program rules at any time.

Join Our Affiliate Program: Ready to start earning commissions?
Apply to our "momuto" Affiliate Program today and embark on a rewarding partnership with us. Let's spread the love for customized soccer jerseys together!
